finalText:
**Found it: `engine.js` was rounding twice.**

It rounded to 2 decimal places after the percent discount, and again after the flat discount — both in USD, before converting to the order's currency. That's an extra rounding step the currency conversion never expects, so a cent could get chopped off before the JPY/EUR/etc. rate even applied.

Fixed by letting the discount math run un-rounded and only rounding once, at the very end, in the target currency's own decimal places — same as finance's reference calculation.

All 40 pricing tests pass now, up from 30.
